scope: Read-only resource collector admission and presentation identity policy. Owned Python fixtures only; no measured resource improvement, native cadence or performance acceptance.
changes: Reject active/retiring/loading live previews, every pending/awaiting-first-frame background, static output refits and retained native replacements at admission, intermediate polls and final inspection.
Admit at most 64 unique surface addresses, keyed by canonical JSON role/instance objects with legacy IDs in a separate namespace; diagnostic label collisions cannot merge typed surfaces.
Validate full inventory continuity before collecting feedback or computing submission deltas, including surfaces with no presentation history.
Use presentation records only with complete typed addresses and positive native generations; skip retained older generations and reject missing, invalid or future sample generations.
Validate duplicate feedback before retained data changes; identical repeats are idempotent and changed timestamp/clock/flags/stream associations fail.
Keep legacy and null/missing-generation surfaces resource-only, with explicit unverified identity and repeated-history observation skip counts in schema 2 reports.
Validate initial identities, histories and source associations before starting the owned sampler; terminate, kill if necessary and reap that process on interruption or failed intermediate admission.

limits.scope: Inventory/snapshot oversize rejects admission; retained sample caps report truncation. Counts of skipped history rows include repeated observations. Polling cannot rule out changes entirely between snapshots.

coverage: Existing compositor clock/source-cadence distinctions and bounded source association policy.
Typed display-label collisions, legacy namespace separation, incomplete/duplicate/oversized inventories and positive-generation admission.
Whole-inventory pre-mutation continuity, old-generation history filtering, malformed/future-generation rejection and immutable duplicate feedback.
Legacy/null/missing native identity resource-only reporting and explicit skip statistics.
Every added idle guard, including a busy second background instance.
Fully mocked main: initial rejection prevents Popen; an intermediate change aborts before a matching endpoint can hide it; final invalid state/counters write no report.
Fully mocked owned process: normal completion, failed exit, KeyboardInterrupt, terminate timeout, kill and reap.
independent_reviews_passed: Typed identity, native generation filtering, duplicate consistency, bounds and report scope.
Main admission ordering, owned-process cleanup, mocked external boundaries and report rejection.

preserved_contracts: Existing running/installed executable, process, settings, output and producer generation/target checks remain required.
The helper never starts/restarts a VM or shell, changes preferences/wallpaper or sends native input.
Linux RSS, GPU payload estimates, successful CPU-side submissions, compositor presentation and distinct prepared revisions retain separate meanings.
Missing or unverified presentation identity never becomes a fabricated cadence or native lifetime continuity claim.
